Using exactly its art style (flat 2D illustration, soft cel shading, thick dark brown outlines, warm pastel palette), draw a sprite sheet on a plain pure white background with these 4 separate items, spaced well apart, none touching: in the top row, three ice cubes side by side, each a translucent pale-blue block of ice shaped to cover one of the rounded meal tickets in image 1, horizontal rounded rectangles the size and shape of a 1-cell, a 2-cell and a 3-cell ticket, from left to right, all the same height, each with bevelled faces in deeper ice blue along its edges, bright pale-blue highlights on the bevels, a few thin frost cracks near its corners and a thick dark brown outline, the centre of each block left clear and empty for a number; in the bottom row, centred, an empty round number badge, a cream disc with a thick ring around its edge drawn in light cream and a thick dark brown outline, its middle empty, no number or text in it. Draw the ice in pale blue and icy cyan tones and the badge in cream, never pure white or very pale grey anywhere (the white background is keyed out), no white highlights larger than tiny glints. Seen from directly above like the tickets in image 1. No tickets underneath, no shadows, no text, nothing else. Wide image, 2:1.
